title: The Saint Maiden Arrives
next_chapter_hook: "The words Ye Qing left before departing were like a blunt knife, slowly and firmly cutting open the deepest scar in Chen Ji's heart—his father's death was far from simple as a natural illness."

text.content: "Broken porcelain slipped through his fingers, making crisp sounds on the blue stone floor. Chen Ji gazed down at the faint red mark on his palm, his expression terrifyingly calm. Ling Yuan, the revered former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, actually had such deep ties with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. 'Interesting.' he murmured, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth. 'It seems this chess game is more complex than I imagined.'"

dialogue.content: "When Ye Qing stepped into the room, the demonic energy surrounding her compressed the air until it felt three times more stagnant. She had changed into a crimson-purple long dress today, with an eerie blue bone hairpin斜插 in her hair. Her gaze swept over Chen Ji's hand that had crushed the teacup, and the corner of her lips slightly lifted. 'Chen Gongzi is quite composed.' Her voice was clear and cold as spring water, yet carried hidden sharpness. 'If it were anyone else, they would have lost their composure long ago.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji rose unhurriedly, casually wiping the blood from his palm on his robe. His gaze lingered on Ye Qing for a moment. This Demonic Path Saint Maiden was younger than he had imagined, her beauty almost妖异, yet every gesture possessed an intimidating aura that forbade direct scrutiny. He quickly calculated in his heart—this presence was something no ordinary disciple could cultivate. It seemed her strength truly could not be underestimated."

dialogue.content: "The Saint Maiden honors my humble dwelling; Chen Ji failed to greet from afar." He clasped his hands, his posture respectful yet unyielding. "May I ask the purpose of the Saint Maiden's visit? Could the Holy Sect already be impatient to make moves against Tianqing Sect?" His tone was mild, yet concealed probing, like casting stones to find the way."

"Ye Qing laughed lightly, that laughter like silver bells, pleasant to the ear yet sending chills down the spine. 'Make moves?' She carelessly sat across from Chen Ji, fingertips gently tapping the table. 'If our Holy Sect truly intended to move against Tianqing Sect, why would they send me, this Saint Maiden, to personally meet a servant disciple?' She lifted her eyes to stare directly at Chen Ji. 'Chen Gongzi, you and I both know clearly—you are no ordinary servant disciple.'"

text.content: "The air seemed to freeze for an instant. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but alarm bells rang in his heart—how much did she know? Was she merely suspicious, or did she already possess conclusive evidence? His fingers moved slightly, the Tianji Record Fragment in his consciousness faintly burning, as if reminding him of this woman's danger level. He secretly庆幸 he hadn't recklessly used his foresight ability, otherwise exposing the Tianji Record's aura before her would have been disastrous."

dialogue.content: "The Saint Maiden jokes.' Chen Ji said lightly, pouring tea for Ye Qing with fluid grace. 'I swept floors in Tianqing Sect's servant quarters for three years; even inner sect elders don't recognize my face. If the Saint Maiden has been misled by villains and received wrong information, that would be laughed at.' His tone was casual, as if genuinely advising her not to be deceived."

choice.prompt: "Ye Qing directly exposed Chen Ji's disguise and brought a mysterious 'gift'. Facing this unfathomable Demonic Path Saint Maiden, Chen Ji needed to decide what posture to adopt in response to this game of chess."

choices.description: "Persist in thetrash persona, use an even more humble posture to lower her vigilance, seek her flaws and weaknesses."
choices.visible_cost: "May be further tested, exposing more vulnerabilities"
choices.visible_reward: "Let Ye Qing underestimate your strength and value, gaining initiative in subsequent negotiations"
choices.risk_hint: "Since she dares to come alone, she probably has some confidence; feigning weakness may not fool her"

text.content: "Chen Ji lowered his eyes, a panicked expression appearing on his face, his voice even trembling slightly. 'The Saint Maiden shouldn't frighten me like this... I'm just a floor sweeper, how could I deserve such praise.' As he spoke, he deliberately stepped back half a pace, as if afraid of bringing misfortune upon himself. Yet in his lowered eyes, a gleam of sharpness flashed, capturing every subtle expression and movement of Ye Qing."

choices.description: "Since she already suspects, might as well lay cards on the table, negotiate as equals, strive for equal terms of cooperation."
choices.visible_reward: "Establish foundation for equal dialogue, making Ye Qing recognize your value and strength"
choices.risk_hint: "Exposing strength too early may make her wary, making subsequent cooperation even more difficult"

text.content: "Chen Ji gently set down the teapot, lifting his eyes to stare directly at Ye Qing. The timidity in his gaze receded like an ebbing tide, replaced by a terrifying depth. 'Since the Saint Maiden knows everything, let's speak plainly.' His voice was calm as water, yet carried undeniable sharpness. 'You graced me with your presence, surely not to chat家常 with this 'trash'?'"

choices.description: "Proactively dangle bait, show the value you can bring to Ye Qing, making her realize cooperation benefits us both."
choices.visible_cost: "Need to reveal part of your cards in advance, letting her know your usefulness"
choices.visible_reward: "Guide negotiation rhythm, making her proactively seek cooperation rather than pressuring from above"
choices.risk_hint: "Revealed bargaining chips may become leverage she uses against you"

text.content: "A meaningful smile slightly lifted the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. 'The Saint Maiden traveled a thousand li, surely not merely to test me.' He leisurely said. 'Why don't we discuss—what you want, what I can give you.' This was straightforward, yet appropriately displayed confidence, as if declaring the chess game was under his control."

"Ye Qing seemed to have anticipated his reaction, her smile deepening. She waved her delicate hand, a幽光 flashing, and an ancient jade pendant appeared on the table out of thin air. The jade pendant was completely black, its surface carved with complex patterns, faintly emanating an aura that made one's heart palpitate. 'This is a gift and also sincerity.' Her voice suddenly lowered. 'Chen Ji, do you recognize this object?'"

"Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The patterns on that jade pendant, he knew them too well—they were exactly the same as the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment, clearly from the same source! He forcefully suppressed the surging waves in his heart, yet his face involuntarily paled. 'This...' His voice somewhat hoarse. 'Where did the Saint Maiden obtain this item?'"

dialogue.content: "This was the legacy item of the previous Tianji Record master.' Ye Qing's voice suddenly became ethereal, as if telling an ancient story. 'He died under Ling Yuan's sword twenty years ago—oh, that's not right, he died under a joint scheme of Ling Yuan and our Holy Sect.' She gazed meaningfully at Chen Ji. 'As I know, he had a son, only five years old when he went missing that year...'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt his mind explode with a thunderous roar. The previous Tianji Record master, his father, Ling Yuan... these fragments wildly spun in his mind, gradually piecing together into a truth that made his entire body grow cold. His father didn't die from illness, but was killed jointly by Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path! And he himself was the next successor chosen by the Tianji Record! From the beginning, this was a chess game carefully laid out for years!"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He lifted his eyes to stare directly at Ye Qing, clarity already restored in his gaze. 'What does the Saint Maiden want by telling me all this?' His voice was low and firm. 'I don't believe a Holy Sect Saint Maiden would，翻旧账 for a Tianqing Sect servant disciple without reason.'"

"Ye Qing stood up, walked to the window, speaking with her back to Chen Ji: 'The Demonic Path Holy Sect's interior is not a monolithic block. Though I am the Saint Maiden, I am constrained on all sides.' She turned around, a trace of sharpness flashing in her eyes. 'I need a person to help me clear away those obstructive obstacles. In exchange—' she said each word deliberately, 'I will help you deal with Ling Yuan, help you investigate your father's true cause of death.'"

choice.prompt: "Ye Qing extended an olive branch, her conditions generous indeed. However, cooperating with the Demonic Path Saint Maiden was no different than making a pact with a tiger. Chen Ji needed to weigh the pros and cons, make a choice."

choices.text: "Accept everything, conspire for the grand cause"
choices.description: "Accept all of Ye Qing's conditions, formally form an alliance, spare no effort to help her seize the supreme position in the Demonic Path."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely entangled in Demonic Path internal struggles, may create irreconcilable conflicts with righteous path stance"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Demonic Path faction support, adding another trump card when confronting Ling Yuan and the Eye of Heavenly Dao"
choices.risk_hint: "This Ye Qing person is unfathomable; even slight carelessness in cooperation could lead to her turning against you"

text.content: "Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then slowly nodded. 'Very well, I agree to you.' He extended his hand, and Ye Qing struck palms with him as an oath. 'But I speak plainly first—if the Saint Maiden ever betrays faith one day, even if Chen Ji has to risk this life, I will make you pay the price.' His voice was calm, yet carried undeniable resolve."

choices.memory_label: 与夜清结成同盟，承诺互相支持

choices.description: "Accept intelligence exchange, but暂不结盟. Maintain independence to act freely, decide depth based on circumstances."
choices.visible_cost: "May miss opportunity for deep cooperation, arouse Ye Qing's dissatisfaction"
choices.visible_reward: "Can attack or defend, not bound by any side"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing may not accept this neither-close-nor-far attitude; negotiations may reach deadlock"

text.content: "Chen Ji shook his head. 'Cooperation is possible, but I have one condition.' His gaze was steady. 'Before we completely trust each other, we are merely trading partners, not allies. You give me intelligence, I help you handle trouble, nothing more.' These words were neither servile nor overbearing, expressing both willingness to cooperate and drawing a clear line."

choices.description: "Not satisfied with existing conditions, proactively propose more demands, test Ye Qing's bottom line and sincerity."
choices.visible_cost: "May激怒 Ye Qing, leading to negotiation breakdown"
choices.visible_reward: "If a deal is reached, will gain resources and intelligence support far exceeding expectations"
choices.risk_hint: "Since Ye Qing dares to come alone, she probably won't be easily intimidated by demands"

text.content: "A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. 'The Saint Maiden's conditions are quite light.' He leisurely fiddled with the jade pendant. 'Ling Yuan is Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master, backed by the entire Xuanwu Sect behind him. A mere intelligence exchange is too lacking in sincerity, wouldn't you say?' He lifted his eyes to stare directly at Ye Qing. 'What I want is not much—the Demonic Path Holy Sect's cultivation manuals, and all your资料 regarding the Eye of Heavenly Dao.'"

"Upon hearing this, Ye Qing not only showed no anger but laughed lightly, that laughter even carrying a hint of admiration. 'Indeed a troublesome character.' She took a yellowed bamboo slip from her sleeve, gently pushing it before Chen Ji. 'This is Demonic Path foundational mental cultivation method, considered a deposit. As for the Eye of Heavenly Dao's资料...' Her gaze suddenly deepened. 'Once you prove your value, I will naturally tell you more.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji accepted the bamboo slip, his神识 probing within, discovering it was indeed a complete Demonic Path orthodox introductory cultivation method, though basic yet comprehensive. He secretly calculated—this Ye Qing is generous indeed, apparently with genuine intent to recruit. 'In that case, I wish us pleasant cooperation.' He stored the bamboo slip in his storage bag. 'Does the Saint Maiden have anything else to entrust?'"

text.content: "Ye Qing did not answer immediately, but slowly walked to stand before Chen Ji, almost face to face with him. That幽冷 fragrance from her body attacked the senses, making one somewhat distracted. But Chen Ji remained unmoved, his gaze still clear as water, meeting her stare. After a moment, Ye Qing softly said: 'One last thing—your father's cause of death may be more complex than you imagine.' She paused. 'Because the person who acted wasn't only Ling Yuan.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji's pupils slightly constricted, his fingers gripping the teacup white from force. He took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions in his heart, yet his voice remained steady: 'What does the Saint Maiden mean by this?' His gaze was like two sharp blades, directly stabbing toward Ye Qing. 'Since we've come this far in words, why not speak clearly once and for all?'"

text.content: "Yet Ye Qing shook her head, gracefully turning toward the door to leave. 'Haste makes waste, Chen Gongzi.' She stopped at the door, sideways revealing a meaningful smile. 'When you establish yourself firmly in Tianqing Sect, when you truly have the qualification to confront Ling Yuan head-on, I will naturally give you this final puzzle piece.' Her figure vanished into the night like a ghost, leaving only ethereal words. 'I look forward to your following performance. Don't disappoint me.'"

"Silence returned to the room. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing toward where Ye Qing had disappeared, his brow furrowed tightly. After a moment, he suddenly laughed lightly, that laughter growing louder, finally even carrying a sense of exhilaration. 'Interesting, truly interesting.' He murmured to himself, palm rubbing that pitch-black jade pendant, his eyes flickering with complex brilliance. 'Ling Yuan, the Demonic Path Holy Sect, the Eye of Heavenly Dao... it seems this chess game is even more spectacular than I imagined.'"

dialogue.content: "He walked to the window, pushed it open, letting the night wind pour in. The distant Tianqing Peak appeared especially majestic under the moonlight, that sect where he had lived for three years, now in his eyes like a giant chessboard. And he, Chen Ji, absolutely refused to be merely a chess piece to be moved at others' will. He clenched his fist, his knuckles clicking from force. 'Father, watch from heaven above.' He vowed in a low voice. 'Those who harmed you, I will not let a single one escape.'"
